mapper.select: SELECT feature_code AS featureCode, COUNT(*) AS count FROM report_ai WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} GROUP BY feature_code ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT feature_code AS featureCode, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM report_ai WHERE family_id = #{familyId} GROUP BY feature_code ORDER BY total DESC
